notes.title: ~Rebalancing + Demo Update~
notes.notes:
[p]I figured a lot of changes were made, so the demo should be updated as well since it doesn't play the same anymore[/p][p][/p][h2]FULL GAME[/h2][h3]
CHANGES:[/h3][list][*][p] Green and interest tiles are now temporary.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] The price of Interest and Green tiles don't scale with each board anymore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] Scoring has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p] Chording doesn't trigger mines when having a shield anymore.[/p][/*][*][p] Prices now scale with rank.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DEMO[/h2][p]The demo has been updated and now has all the fixes and changes from the current version, differences:[/p][list][*][p]No achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Only first 2 Faces can be played (Jimmy/Joe)[/p][/*][*][p]Only first 2 flags can be used (Red/Blue)[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3]

notes.title: --Dragging the camera, bugfixes and more!--
notes.notes: [h1]I heard some people wanted to be able to [i][b]drag the board[/b][/i] to see better, so i did that![/h1][p][i][u]Also, got rid of more annoying bugs and changed some stuff for better communication[/u][/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]--CHANGES--[/b][/h3][list][*][p] You can drag the board by pressing middle click, to see better at higher zoom levels[/p][/*][*][p] Faces now wear sunglasses when you still have uses of your ability, and have a poker-face when you got no uses left, as an indicator.[/p][/*][*][p] Face description also changes when you can't currently use you ability[/p][/*][*][p] The game now remembers the last face, flag and rank you selected.[/p][/*][*][p] At the bottom of the shop, progression is now clearer so you know what challenge you're facing next[/p][/*][*][p] Jimmy's Description is now shorter to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p] Social media has been moved to a corner instead of being with the rest of the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added version number to the bottom of main menu to help with bug reports[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]--FIXES--[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Safe clicks don't get disabled when clicking a flagged tile. This also fixes the Regular Joe bug where it wouldn't let you use the ability right after.[/p][/*][*][p] Safe clicks don't get disabled with chording anymore.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where blue flag wouldn't allow you to use your skill after use[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where blue flag would kill you if you hit a mine on your first click, instead of relocating it.[/p][/*][/list]
